featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased health insurance for three family members from Tata AIG through Sejal Insurance, and it has been one of the worst decisions. They make big promises at the time of selling the policy but provide absolutely no support during the claim reimbursement process.

My post-hospitalization claim from September 2025 is still pending. Despite repeated follow-ups, I am only told that they are “awaiting a reply” from the company. Their staff keeps changing, and every time I have to explain my case from the beginning. There is zero accountability and no proactive assistance.

I even tried reaching out to the CEO, Ms. Faalguni, but she was apparently too busy to address customer concerns.

If you value your time and money, avoid going through such brokers. It is far better to purchase insurance directly from the company rather than trusting agencies that make false commitments. I would strongly caution others before choosing Sejal Insurance.
